paragraphs: POM sells parking meters and dates the first parking meter installed in Oklahoma City to 1935. Meters are manufactured at a woman-owned, ISO-certified facility in Russellville, Arkansas. The meters use a power management chip, a low-power modem, and a memory LCD graphic display.

All POM parking meters can be programmed to accept prepaid smart chip cards, alone or in conjunction with coins. The card is a ParkCard, sized to fit into a pocket or wallet. Refund-a-Card is a programming option developed for closed card systems. When a motorist reinserts the card, the value of the left-over time is refunded to that card and the meter is reset to zero.

MeterManager.net has a smart card management module that uses a USB card reader and writer interface. That module lets the parking system administrator issue smartcards and add value to depleted cards.

quote.text: POM is the originator of metered parking
